messages.content: You are the Chief Architecture Advisor for EvolvixOS. Review this phase, provide a score (1-10), identify issues by severity, and recommend next steps.

PHASE 123 IMPLEMENTATION REPORT: Developer Support System v1.0

## Summary
Built a complete Developer Support System with documentation, tutorials, community forum, and developer resources. 4 docs, 3 tutorials seeded. Live at https://evolvixos.com/dev-support/.

## Components Built

### 1. Documentation Manager
- 4 pre-seeded docs: Getting Started, SDK Guide, API Reference, FAQ
- 8 documentation categories: getting-started, sdk, api-reference, guides, tutorials, examples, faq, changelog
- Full-text search across title, content, and tags
- View tracking, helpful/not-helpful voting
- CRUD endpoints: list, get, create, mark-helpful
- PostgreSQL table: dev_docs (title, slug, category, content, excerpt, author, tags, version, status, sort_order, views, helpful_count)

### 2. Tutorial System
- 3 pre-seeded tutorials: Build First Smart Contract (beginner, 15min), Create AI Agent (intermediate, 20min), Publish Plugin (advanced, 25min)
- Each tutorial has: steps (JSONB), code examples (JSONB), difficulty (beginner/intermediate/advanced), duration
- View and completion tracking
- CRUD endpoints: list, get, create, mark-complete
- PostgreSQL table: dev_tutorials (title, slug, description, difficulty, duration_minutes, steps, code_examples, tags, views, completions)

### 3. Community Forum
- Question posts with categories, tags, upvotes/downvotes, views
- Reply system with accepted answers (like StackOverflow)
- Voting on posts and replies
- Endpoints: list posts, get post with replies, create post, create reply, vote, accept reply
- 2 PostgreSQL tables: community_posts (title, body, author, category, tags, upvotes, downvotes, views, reply_count, status, accepted_answer), community_replies (post_id, body, author, upvotes, is_accepted)
- Input sanitization on all community submissions

### 4. Developer Resources Overview
- GET /resources endpoint aggregating all developer resources
- Links to all platform services (AI Gateway, Contracts, Marketplace, Platform, Agents)
- SDK installation instructions (Python pip, TypeScript npm)
- CLI installation instructions
- 8 documentation categories listed

### 5. Production Deployment
- Docker container: devsupport-api (port 4900)
- Nginx route: https://evolvixos.com/dev-support/
- PostgreSQL integration with 4 tables (dev_docs, dev_tutorials, community_posts, community_replies)
- 4 docs, 3 tutorials seeded
- 30 total Docker containers running

## Test Results
- 24 developer support tests (all passing)
- 458 total tests passed across all key test suites
- Tests cover: docs CRUD, tutorials CRUD, community posts/replies/voting, resources, health, models

## Platform State
- 30 Docker containers
- 458+ tests passing
- Developer Support v1.0 with docs, tutorials, community, resources
- 4 docs, 3 tutorials, community forum live
- 15 production services running

## GPT-4o Score History
- Phase 122: 8/10 (Scalability + Paid Plugins + Verification)
- Phase 121: 8/10 (Security + Dependencies + Versioning)
- Phase 120: 8/10 (Plugin Marketplace)

## Questions for GPT-4o
1. Is the developer support architecture correct for an enterprise platform?
2. Should we add more community features (badges, reputation, notifications)?
3. Should we integrate the docs with the existing Documentation API from Phase 93?
4. What should Phase 124 be?
5. Are there missing developer support features?
